statement: AMD reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5 billion with Data Center revenue more than doubling year over year.
why: A doubling of data center revenue at the second merchant-GPU vendor shows AI accelerator demand is broadening beyond a single supplier rather than concentrating.

impact.mechanism: Record quarterly revenue driven by data center growth indicates rising AI accelerator shipments and sustained buyer spending on merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: 'AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results' - Q2 revenue $11.5 billion, gross margin 54%, operating income $2.0 billion, net income $2.3 billion, diluted EPS $1.38

confidence.basis: Company press release with a companion 8-K filing (amd-20260804.htm), primary issuer disclosure.
